Priyanka / team — I pulled a draft of the hero and feature bullets, pasted below with suggested edits. Small ask: can you confirm the primary customer persona (data scientist, analytics platform owner, or platform infra) so we angle the one-liner?

Draft (suggested changes in brackets):
Hero one-liner:
- "Acme Analytics connector for Redwood Inference — low-latency model inference on your metrics and event data, with predictable unit economics." [suggest: drop jargon; propose: "Serve ML-driven analytics on your data with low latency and predictable cost."]

Top benefits (3 bullets):
- "Fast inference across owned datasets with built-in caching and batching." [suggest: "Low-latency inference with built-in cache & batching to reduce cost."]
- "Secure VPC deployment options and audit logging for compliance."
- "Simple billing integration through AWS Marketplace private offers or pay-as-you-go." [suggest clarifying what is supported: private offers + SaaS metering?]

Usage examples (short):
- "Realtime anomaly detection for logistics pipelines (example workload)."
- "Ad-hoc model scoring for BI dashboards (example)."

Action items for our sync:
- Priyanka: confirm persona + any compliance claims you need (SOC2, HIPAA).
- Acme: share final screenshots and confirm logo variants for dark/light backgrounds.
- Redwood: we’ll prepare AMI guidance and private-offer example language.

Attaching a quick doc with inline copy suggestions: acme_product-copy-suggestions.docx

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | GTM Enablement, Redwood Inference

Hi all — looping in a couple legal/procurement items so Acme can plan internally. High level:

- Private Offer flow: we’ll need a PO and signatory details from Acme to create a Private Offer in AWS. DocuSign link is included below for a standard reseller agreement (if you already have a vendor contract on file we can attach instead).
- Data claims & compliance: if you intend to claim SOC 2/HIPAA support on the product page, please share the attestation or the report summary. We’ll need the exact phrasing for the marketplace copy.
- AMI packaging: if you ship an AMI, confirm it passes AWS best-practices (no hardcoded creds, only required ports open). We can provide Redwood’s AMI checklist and a mapping table for SKU -> sellerid to enable Private Offers for AMI SKU.

DocuSign (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/ACMEPO-887
HubSpot contact: https://hubspot.example/contacts/ACME-3421

Please reply with the PO signatory name, billing address, and whether you want us to start a private-offer draft. If you prefer to close via standard SaaS metering instead of private offers, tell us and we’ll route to the marketplace billing team.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Partner Ops & Legal, Redwood Inference
